Hi Justin,

Thanks for writing, and sorry the wait on this one has stretched further than you planned for.

Here is where it stands. Your Magic Miner 40T on Shop···· is a pre-order, and your unit is already allocated to the production run being built right now. The control board issue that stopped the first run is fixed and the final version is approved. All 300 units are built and shipped together, and Magic Miner expects them to leave the factory on November 12. Your order's ship date is December 7, and your tracking is emailed the moment your miner ships. You can follow the shipment on its way to us here: https://heliumdeploy.com/pages/shipment-status

Before we talk about cancelling, two things that might suit you better, since you said you are set for miners until the new year. We can turn the full $839 into store credit on your account, so none of the value is lost and you can spend it on whatever we launch in the new year. Or we can swap the 40T for something we have on the shelf now, and I will tell you exactly what the difference comes to first.

Just tell me which you prefer and I will take care of it.

Sarah, HeliumDeploy Support
